payload.question: The evaluate session has a follow-up branch, feat/evaluate-limits. It records the answers you gave today to its three questions. Run limits become optional and off by default: with no limit given, a run does nothing and says to ask you. A held merge now stops its loop and says why. It also records the proof of its fix loop and links the six task files. Shall I land it once the current landing job finishes?
